Sine wave LFO modulating pitch 0.3 out of 100 (very slightly), set at a rate of 1.16 Hz, just above once per second. So a slight tape warble gives it that drify authenticity.
Attack is quick, just a few ms, decay is long, roughly 4.5 s, with a sustain at about 64%, just enough to give it some punch of attack.
Envelope Filter Amt is modulating cutoff at 34.1, and cutoff is set at about 814 Hz, with a slight LPF resonance peak at .625.

A paraphonic SawX voice with heavy chorus (Shape 0.666) through a resonant low-pass filter that the main envelope opens. With sustain at 0.665 and no attack, held notes stay steady after a short bright onset.

In GitP/A/Session/26/11/23-Mon it opens the episode on the first sequencer track and its held loop runs under the next two chapters. The log names it first; no commentary announces it, and the session MIDI records no knob moves before the next preset.

A monophonic Harm voice two octaves down through a nearly closed, very resonant low-pass filter. The Cycling Envelope opens the filter on each note, so the sound is a sub bass with a short resonant bloom.

Pressure bends pitch slightly (+0.050) and speeds up the sawtooth LFO through Assign 1 (+0.497). GitP/A/Log/26/11/23-Mon notes that touch detunes and adds vibrato, which matches those two matrix rows; the LFO's only saved destination is a small amount of cutoff, so the vibrato heard may come from the pitch row rather than the LFO.
In GitP/A/Session/26/11/23-Mon it is the sub-bass loop on the second sequencer track from 00:17, with low F and G played on the keys from 00:25.
